headline: FourthCanvas Expands to the UK and Appoints Country Director
summary: Nigerian design consultancy FourthCanvas established a UK operation, appointed Tunji Ogunoye as Country Director, and secured its first fintech client in the market as it celebrated its 11th anniversary.
why: International expansions into mature markets such as the UK represent significant strategic milestones for growing design consultancies and can diversify revenue streams away from domestic markets.
